text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin, with 45 mph winds, is in the Coral Sea near 14.8s/153.4e, moving east at 9 mph. The system should slowly weaken as it moves east and then back west during the next 48-72 hours. This system continues to threaten shipping and boating in the Coral Sea during this period. Coastal areas of northeast Queensland will continue to see rough surf and possible beach erosion during this period.

Tropical cyclone 33p has formed with 40 mph winds north of the Fiji islands. This system is expected to strengthen as it tracks south and then southeast during the next 48 hours. It will become an increasing risk to shipping during the next 24-48 hours as winds increase to about 75 mph. It is expected to threaten the Fiji islands in a little over 48 hours. Strong winds and heavy rains may move into the islands at that time.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
